title: Perfluoroalkyl acid precursor discharge from engineered water systems: composition and treatment impacts
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00042H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lois D. Arku, Juhe Liu, Joseph A. Charbonnet
Conventional PFAS monitoring underestimates environmental loading by failing to account for oxidizable perfluoroalkyl acid precursors. Precursors accounted for up to 92% of influent PFAS and nearly half of the total PFAS mass released.
